text:
ivy-release: Start 10m until EU critical freeze. Creating single-thread checklist for slice-A. Keep replies short.

sam-oncall: I'll coordinate rollback comms to #release-war-room if needed.

leo-dev: Note: no new model pins or uploads during freeze. If we revert, use admin endpoint (example in runbook).

anya-sre: Infra checks: spare nodes >=2, GPU mem headroom >=10%, node-drain tested. I'll create alerts for restart-loop and high mem.

ivy-release: Ramp plan: 0->8% over 10m, hold for 10m. Abort if user errors >1% sustained 3m OR smoke regressions >12 in 20m.

deploy-bot: Quiet freeze policy 'eu-freeze-5381234567' -> blocking pin endpoints and noncritical deploys. Policy active.

leo-dev: Smoke run scheduled at T+4m. I'll post summary.

anya-sre: Added alert `freeze/eu-node-restarts` (5m) and `freeze/eu-gpu-pressure` (3m). If triggered, I'll flip traffic to fallback and notify.

sam-oncall: Rollback steps: 1) announce in #release-war-room with short format 2) run pin revert (leo) 3) deploy-bot pause ramp 4) infra route to fallback (anya).

leo-dev: first smoke: 0 regressions / 100 checks, p95=260ms.

ivy-release: owners ack?

leo-dev: ack.

anya-sre: ack.

sam-oncall: ack and monitoring.

ivy-release: launching ramp in 2m. Keep critical updates here; move incidents to #release-war-room. Thanks.
